title: Named Non-Owner Policy Renewal Offer Premium: Rate Page
content:
**Renewal offer premium.** For a Named Non-Owner Policy renewal on which the package is kept, the renewal offer premium is the base rate of the expiring term's package multiplied by the state factor, by the points class factor, by the renewal term's months over six and by the lapse relativity, rounded half up to the cent on the final figure only. The renewal term runs from the expiring term's expiration date, which is included, for the same number of months.

**Base rates** (the company's six-month base rate of the package rated):

| Package | Six-month base rate (USD) |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits | 520.00 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits with UM | 610.00 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 50/100/50 | 760.00 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50 | 880.00 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50 | 950.00 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 250/500/100 | 1180.00 |

**State factors** (residence state):

| Residence state | FL | VA | TX | GA | AZ | OH |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| State factor | 1.00 | 0.94 | 1.08 | 1.05 | 0.97 | 0.88 |

**Points class factors** (the named insured's violation points on the term):

| Named insured's violation points on the term | 0 to 2 | 3 to 5 | 6 to 9 | 10 or more |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Points class factor | 1.00 | 1.12 | 1.28 | 1.50 |

**Lapse relativity.** It follows the most recent lapse recorded on the expiring term, its days counted from the first through the last lapse day, both included, and its lapse window, the 6 whole months that follow the first lapse day, a month being complete on the same day of the following month. The window's remaining months at the renewal are 6 less the whole months from the first lapse day to the renewal effective date.

| Lapse days | Remaining months above zero | Remaining months zero or less |
|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | 1.12 | none |
| 3 to 5 | 1.06 | none |
| 1 or 2 | none | none |
| no lapse | none | none |

**Worked example (hypothetical inputs).** Expiring package Cardinal Point Non-Owner 50/100/50, residence state VA, 1 violation point, six-month renewal; a 4-day lapse whose first day falls two whole months before the renewal effective date, so four months remain: 760.00 multiplied by 0.94, by 1.00, by six over six and by 1.06 gives 757.26.
